Public.load: load() -> (table,effects,controls,manifest); verifies CURRENT/event/snapshot/all declared hashes/axis/finite values
Public.rollback: rollback_to(version:int,reason:str) -> CURRENT pointer; earlier version only

Error.manifest: manifest(upstream_model_id,model_version) -> verified manifest plus runtime revision fields
Error.immutable_path: root/<core-hashed-key>/revisions/r0001,r0002; each revision is a core ErrorMemoryRegistry root

Serving.publish: publish(component,version,reason) -> serving pointer; RELEASED versions only
Serving.current: current(component) -> verified immutable artifact copy Path
Serving.rollback: rollback(component,to_version,reason) -> serving pointer; invokes actual ModelRegistry.rollback

scientific_boundary: No fitting, gate selection or evaluation reads; caller decides RELEASED/REJECTED from its frozen scientific gates
staging: Actual Public/Error calls run in isolated stages before immutable snapshots and active pointers are installed
